name: Karasawa Rei
source:
Chef at a curry shop.
The do-S one at the boarding house.
A former student of the university who continues to live at the student only boarding house for the self-centered reason that it is close to his place of work.
He works at an Indian curry shop with an Indian shop owner, but he's a selfish curry idiot who only makes his own type of curry.
